end.summary:
Multiplication by 10, 100 and 1000 was practised using place value.
Sameer attempted two unaided questions; neither was correct.
They added zeros in some examples but mixed up the resulting place value.
They doubled both factors when trying to simplify multiplication.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised multiplying by 10, 100 and 1000 with Sameer, focusing on place value and adding zeros. Sameer tried using zero-placement and doubling methods, but mixed up the answer and the number of zeros; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise a few examples by saying the place-value shift aloud before writing the answer.
